About this hotel

Set on a residential tree-lined street, this relaxed hotel is 2 blocks from the beach, 2.4 km from Giulianova train station and 3 km from Museo D'Arte dello Splendore

SeaPark SPA Resort, Giulianova (updated prices 2027)
Seapark Spa Resort is 1.2 mi from Giulianova and a 1-minute walk from the seaside. It offers an outdoor pool with hot tub, an indoor pool, and a spa.
